{{Quote|Watch your stabilizer, Gold Six!|A clone trooper pilot|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] flew under the the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Gold Six'''" during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]], during [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]]. Under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Gold Squadron departed from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Gold Six and Gold Squadron were planning to stop a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], which was led by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. When the squadron confronted Grievous' [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warships]] fired at Gold Six and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]], resulting in casualties and forcing Gold Squadron to retreat. However, Skywalker continued toward the approaching [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The squadron managed to draw Grievous' attention away from Republic [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] hidden in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime's]] [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], which greatly contributed to the Confederate fleet's eventual destruction.

==Biography==
[[File:GoldSquadron-DoaD.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker leads Gold Squadron.]]
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Gold Six" was part of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="doad" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] learned that [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] planned to [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|invade]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] vital to Republic intelligence because of their adept [[Spy/Legends|information-collecting abilities]]. A [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was sent to protect Bothawui.<ref name="ws">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> Although the Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] led by Skywalker was outnumbered, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General decided to stay and defend Bothawui. In order to prevent a Confederate invasion of the planet, he placed several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], on [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] above<ref name="doad" /> the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Confederate fleet, consisting of six [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and Grievous ordered the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to navigate through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], intending to use the asteroids as cover from Republic [[Laser/Legends|fire]].<ref name="doad" />

[[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], Gold Six, along with the rest of his squadron, departed from the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="doad" /> [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]<ref name="ws" /> to stop the approaching fleet. Skywalker led the squadron from his own [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. However, as Skywalker wanted the Confederate ships to approach closer, so that the [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] on the asteroids could start firing at them, he ordered Gold Six and his squadron to hold their positions. Grievous' ships opened fire, causing damage to one of the three Republic Star Destroyers. During the ensuing battle, a [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Bothawui)|fellow pilot]] told Gold Six to watch his stabilizer. Skywalker eventually ordered Gold Squadron to proceed toward the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], but one of the V-19 Torrent starfighters was hit by laser fire and crashed into another starfighter. The Jedi General then ordered the rest of the squadron to retreat, while he proceeded toward the Confederate fleet. Gold Squadron managed to draw Grievous' attention away from the AT-TEs, which ambushed the fleet and eventually helped destroy the frigates, although Grievous was able to flee.<ref name="doad" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all clone troopers, Gold Six stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] pilot using the call sign "Gold Six" was mentioned in "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," the sixth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which released on [[November 7]], [[2008]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> The line from "Downfall of a Droid" wherein Gold Six is mentioned also appears during the opening credits of the animated film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]<ref name="tcwfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> which was released on [[August 15]], 2008.<ref name="ann">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news/announcement.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' In Theaters and on Television in 2008}}</ref> However, as the scene does not tie into the film itself, the line cannot be considered to be a part of the film's actual storyline.<ref name="tcwfilm" />
